statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-44510 was rejected as a duplicate of CVE-2026-43620 (see https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-44510). The issue addressed by CVE-2026-43620 was fixed in upstream rsync 3.4.3. This package ships Debian rsync 3.5.0+ds1 (upstream 3.5.0), which includes that fix.

CVE-2026-44509 was rejected as a duplicate of CVE-2026-43619 (see https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-44509). The symlink race in path-based syscalls was fixed in upstream rsync 3.4.3. This package ships Debian rsync 3.5.0+ds1 (upstream 3.5.0), which includes that fix.
